text: Ninigi came down from heaven through eight layers of clouds to the top of Mount Takachiho, on the island of Kyushu.
spoken: Nee-nee-gee came down from heaven through eight layers of clouds to the top of Mount Tah-kah-chee-ho, on the island of Kyoo-shoo.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
